findings.detail: The live-site dedup gate verifies hashes of supplied extracted text, but does not verify the raw page responses or reconstruct that text from them. HTTP status, final URL and retrieval time are also supplied fields. Thus a self-consistent but incorrect capture can support a DISTINCT verdict without establishing the actual live content.
findings.required_fix: Archive and hash each raw response, bind its retrieval metadata, and reconstruct the reviewed text from those bytes. Hold the dedup gate when this evidence or adequate site coverage is missing; add a regression test for a self-consistent extracted-text mismatch.

findings.detail: Startup checks out approved_main_sha after the entry point has loaded modules from the permitted code SHA, without explicitly requiring the two SHAs to match. With a differently bound approved plan, the process could run already-imported code from one commit while reading review inputs and later imports from another. The supplied plan currently uses the same SHA for both.
findings.required_fix: Require code SHA and approved main SHA to match before checkout, or execute the complete reviewed runtime from an immutable worktree without switching its source tree. Test a valid permit with differing SHAs and assert failure before credential access.

cloud-pilot-manual.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge multilingual API pilot
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Offline inspection or separately approved real execution
        type: choice
        options: [preflight, account-check, audit, execute]
        default: preflight
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: autobridge-entire-real-pilot-program
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  trusted:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: xysjou/AutoBridge-Content-Pipeline/.github/workflows/cloud-pilot-trusted.yml@b3f5a6cef20b8dc235f001af306e635f1eca0fdf
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode }}
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}

cloud-pilot-trusted.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge pinned protected runtime
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: string
        required: true
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256:
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    if: inputs.mode == 'preflight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preflight
  account-check:
    # Availability is inspected inside the code/lease-preauthorized execute path.
    # Disable the legacy standalone key-bearing path permanently.
    if: ${{ false }}
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Inspect only the two configured model metadata endpoints
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_ACCOUNT_CHECK_APPROVED: 'true'
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual account-check
  execute:
    if: >-
      (inputs.mode == 'execute' || inputs.mode == 'audit') &&
      vars.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/work-cloud-pilot-m1-20261102'
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Fetch reviewed control documents from a separate immutable commit
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVAL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual.control
      - name: Validate exact run and workflow lease before exposing the project key
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preauthorize
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"
      - name: Execute approved phase with the existing whole-program budget
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
          APPROVED_RUN_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual "$APPROVED_RUN_MODE"
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"

articles.reason: The 2024 China-market Q05 reserve is a PHEV, whereas this topic targets the identified 2026 China-market BEV reference; the reserve does not establish that they are the same vehicle or answer the newer vehicle’s buyer question. Existing live SUV-shortlisting guides provide regional selection methods, and the AION Y page is another model reference, but the supplied live-site corpus contains no Q05-specific page with this exact model-year, powertrain and buyer-decision intent. Keep the scope on verifying the 2026 BEV identity and evaluating it as an urban sourcing candidate. Stock, production end and export equivalence remain Research questions, not claims or a recommendation to buy.

The existing Foton Aumark page is a model-specific reefer buyer guide focused on keeping chassis, insulated body and refrigeration unit separate; the Tianjin KR page likewise covers a particular reefer build. The fleet and PDI/transport material addresses broader procurement or handover controls. The proposed buyer task is narrower and distinct if it remains an acceptance-evidence guide for an already completed refrigerated truck: define and record the acceptance demonstration, including VIN/equipment identity, operating conditions, sensor records, door-opening pattern, power modes and responsibility. Do not turn it into another model/configuration shopping guide or repeat generic vehicle PDI.
